text:
maya: Heads-up — planning run-of-show & checklist for next Wed's webinar 'Benchmarking Inference at Scale'. Need sign-up page, Zoom config, recording plan, and post-event nurture flow. Who owns what?
felix: I can own Zoom + live ops. Quick Q: will we use cloud recording or local backup?
maya: Cloud for transcripts + auto captions. But we also want a local SRT backup and RTMP fallback in case of Zoom issues.
elena: For the registration page, let's capture: name, work email, company, role, consent checkbox, use-case dropdown (prod/dev/research). Also add hidden UTMs and a 2-line survey: "primary challenge" and "volume of requests/month".
sam: HubSpot mapping? We should send job title -> contact property, use-case -> custom field, and UTM params to Campaign. I'll make the Zap/HubSpot form mapping.
felix: Zoom settings checklist (I'll paste):
```
- Cloud recording: enabled (audio, gallery), auto-transcript: enabled
- Alternative host: felix@redwood.ai
- Waiting room: off (we'll control via panel)
- Host only screen share: on
- RTMP fallback enabled -> Stream key to live-stream failover ticket
- Local backup: host recording to laptop (recording folder: /webinar/backups)
```
maya: Nice. Elena, can you prep speaker instructions for mic presets, slide aspect (16:9), and a 2-min intro script?
elena: Yup. Also will ask speakers to upload 1x 16:9 slide PNG for clip thumbnails.
ops-bot: Reminder: resource booking — GPU demo VM reserved 2026-03-04 09:00-10:30 PT for live demo (owner: felix).
sam: Post-event follow-up plan: 1) Immediate replay + slides email w/in 2 hours; 2) 48hr segmented nurture: leads who watched >50% -> send product trial CTA; others -> send highlight clip + short survey.
felix: Recording export notes: request cloud recording as MP4 + SRT. After the webinar, I'll export cloud->S3, tag with event name + timestamp, and kick off clip-extraction job.
maya: Who's doing the 1-minute social clips? we need 3 variants (teaser, key insight, CTA).
elena: I can cut slices and add captions. Will use the transcript timestamps to pick 30s segments.
sam: Routing: high-intent leads (company size >50 & indicated prod use-case) -> Sales SDR queue; others -> MQL nurture. I'll add scoring rules in HubSpot.
maya: Email sequence content notes: subject variants A/B test: "Replay: How to cut LLM cost 3x" vs "Our benchmarks: inference cost & latency tradeoffs". Also include TL;DR bullets and 2 CTAs (Trial + Watch full).
felix: Contingency plan: if Zoom fails, switch to RTMP -> Vimeo Live. ops-bot will post fallback link to #marketing and #eng-runtime.
zelda: (joining) I can own captions QA — check SRT timestamps and speaker labels within 4 hours post.
maya: Good. Ownership recap: felix = Zoom & recording exports, elena = assets & clips, sam = lead routing + HubSpot, zelda = captions QA, maya = promo + email copy.
felix: Timeline: rehearsal Fri 10:00 PT, panel start Wed 09:00 PT, wrap 10:00 PT. Rehearsal checklist: mic check, screen share, slide order, demo connectivity.
elena: I'll send speaker brief with rehearsal invite and a short Loom on uploading slides.
sam: For analytics, add UTM_campaign=webinar_inference_q2 and track playback via Wistia/YouTube embed events.
maya: Post-event deliverables owner: replay page (marketing), short clips (content), transcript + captions (zelda), lead attachments in HubSpot (sam).
felix: I'll create a shared folder: /campaigns/webinar-inference/recordings and put raw + edited assets there.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll finalize the run-of-show doc and share the calendar invite. Please add any missing items here before EOD. :thumbsup:
